title: DAL Professional Expert Annotator
description:
Remote \| Independent Contractor \| Global

About Agents Only Technologies

Agents Only Technologies Inc. is a global workforce and operations company supporting technology, language, and data initiatives across multiple industries. We build scalable contributor ecosystems and collaborate with global organizations to deliver high\-quality solutions across research, analytics, engineering, healthcare, legal, and professional domains.

Our global network of contributors supports projects requiring deep subject matter expertise, analytical thinking, and a commitment to quality, accuracy, and continuous improvement.

Role Overview

We are seeking experienced Domain and Subject Matter Experts to support advanced data, evaluation, and analytical projects requiring specialized professional knowledge. This opportunity is ideal for highly skilled professionals, researchers, and practitioners who possess deep expertise within their respective fields.

As a DAL Niche Expert Annotator, you will apply your professional knowledge to review, analyze, and evaluate complex content while ensuring high standards of quality, accuracy, and consistency. You will contribute domain\-specific insights, assess outputs and reasoning, and support projects that require expert\-level judgment and attention to detail.

This opportunity is well suited for professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, applying evidence\-based reasoning, and contributing to high\-quality knowledge and evaluation initiatives.

What You'll Do

* Review and evaluate domain\-specific content for accuracy, consistency, and quality
* Analyze complex information and provide expert assessments based on established principles and best practices
* Identify factual errors, inconsistencies, and areas requiring improvement
* Compare and rank alternative approaches, explanations, and outputs
* Document findings and provide clear rationale for evaluations
* Apply professional judgment and subject matter expertise to challenging scenarios
* Maintain alignment with industry standards, research methodologies, and domain\-specific practices
* Support projects involving analysis, research, quality evaluation, and structured reasoning
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams supporting technical, scientific, and professional initiatives

What You Bring

Required Experience

* 5\+ years of professional, academic, or research experience within a specialized field
* Demonstrated expertise in one or more professional disciplines
* Experience conducting analysis, evaluations, research, or technical reviews
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent written communication and documentation abilities
* Experience working with complex information and applying structured methodologies

Required Skills

* Strong domain expertise within your area of specialization
* Ability to evaluate information with accuracy and consistency
* Strong analytical and critical thinking capabilities
* Excellent written communication and documentation skills
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
* Strong research and evaluation skills
* Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly and effectively

Education/Expertise

Candidates with educational background, certifications, research experience, or professional expertise in one or more of the following areas are encouraged to apply:

Medical Doctors / Clinical Professionals

* Physicians, Surgeons, Specialists
* Nurses, Nurse Practitioners, Physician Assistants
* Oncology, Cardiology, Psychiatry, Neurology, Internal Medicine, and related specialties
* Board\-certified professionals preferred

Legal Experts / Attorneys

* Licensed Attorneys
* Paralegals and Legal Researchers
* Contract Law, Intellectual Property, Compliance, Criminal Law, Regulatory Affairs, and related practice areas

STEM / Mathematics Experts

* Pure Mathematics
* Applied Mathematics
* Statistics
* Physics
* Research Scientists and Professors
* Advanced degrees strongly preferred

Biologists / Life Scientists

* Molecular Biology
* Genetics
* Biochemistry
* Biomedical Sciences
* Ecology
* Life Sciences Research
* Laboratory experience preferred

Financial Analysts / Accountants

* CPAs, CFAs, Financial Analysts
* Investment Professionals
* Banking, Asset Management, Accounting, and Financial Services backgrounds preferred

Cybersecurity Professionals

* Security Engineers
* Penetration Testers
* Ethical Hackers
* SOC Analysts
* Governance, Risk, and Compliance Specialists
* Certifications such as CISSP, CEH, OSCP, and related credentials are highly valued

Linguists / NLP Language Experts

* Linguistics
* Computational Linguistics
* Translation and Localization
* Language Documentation
* Multilingual expertise strongly preferred

Psychologists / Behavioral Scientists

* Clinical Psychology
* Neuropsychology
* Behavioral Science
* Cognitive Science
* UX Research
* Experimental Psychology

Philosophers / Ethics Researchers

* Moral Philosophy
* Applied Ethics
* Political Theory
* Public Policy
* Ethics and Governance
* Advanced academic backgrounds strongly preferred

Data Scientists / ML Engineers

* Data Science
* Statistics
* Machine Learning
* Computer Science
* Quantitative Research
* Python, R, and modern analytical frameworks preferred

Equivalent professional experience will also be considered.

You'll Excel In This Role If You

* Enjoy solving complex problems and analytical challenges
* Possess strong professional judgment and attention to detail
* Stay current with developments within your field of expertise
* Can communicate technical or domain\-specific concepts clearly and effectively
* Thrive in environments requiring precision and consistency
* Take ownership and continuously seek opportunities to improve quality
* Have experience mentoring, teaching, conducting research, or leading professional initiatives
* Are passionate about advancing excellence within your domain

Compensation

Compensation Rate Range (USD/hr): $25–$200

Actual earnings may vary based on task availability, productivity, quality performance, project requirements, niche expertise, certifications, and business needs.

Work Arrangement

* Location: Remote
* Work Type: Independent Contractor
* Scope: Global
* Schedule: Flexible

Equal Opportunity

Agents Only Technologies Inc. is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse global community. We welcome talented individuals from a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Opportunities are made available based on qualifications, skills, experience, and business needs, with the goal of building a collaborative environment where contributors can learn, grow, and succeed together.

title: (Senior) Director, Business Development - AI Drug Discovery
description:
**Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry?**


Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real\-world evidence to deliver real\-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time.

**(Senior) Director, Business Development \- AI Drug Discovery**

### **About Tempus**


Tempus is a healthcare technology company at the forefront of precision medicine and the Al revolution. Our proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real\-world evidence (RWD/E) to deliver actionable insights to providers and life sciences. Beginning in Oncology, Tempus has now expanded into other areas including Neurology, Cardiology, Radiology, rare diseases, and more. Tempus’ offerings can be segmented across two distinct, yet interconnected verticals:

* Diagnostics: molecular and algorithmic tests to generate insights for providers
* Data and Apps: multimodal data and solutions to power life sciences R\&D


Within our Data and Apps business unit, we are pioneering the use of AI with Tempus’ vast data and sample repository to empower researchers to bridge the gaps from hypothesis to the lab and eventually to the clinic, and brings together a few of our key life science offerings. Most notably our oncology\-focused AI\-drug discovery platform for target identification and validation that connects multimodal real\-world patient data and a clinically\-annotated biorepository with high\-throughput CRISPR screening on patient\-derived organoids in a closed “lab\-in\-the\-loop” workflow. These AI\-enabled workflows rest on the industry’s largest oncology foundation model and can be validated in the largest human\-derived clinically annotated biorepository for contextualization in Tempus’ real\-world dataset to guide drug development.

### **The Opportunity**


We are seeking a Director/Senior Director of Business Development to join our team, with a focus on AI drug discovery with large biopharma. This role is responsible for establishing and expanding high\-value partnerships by deploying a consultative, enterprise sales approach.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Commercial Discipline: Maintain a rigorous focus on meeting/exceeding bookings and revenue goals, managing all activity and forecasting within Salesforce.
* Pipeline Execution: Drive top\-of\-funnel opportunity creation, manage contract pull\-through, and stay informed on the shifting pipelines/priorities for target accounts
* Integrated Opportunity Generation: Build and execute an account\-based prospecting strategy targeting Discovery, Translational, and Clinical Development functions.
* Consultative Solution Design: Work closely with pharma partners to understand their R\&D objectives, determining where Tempus offerings can most effectively impact their pipelines, programs and research objectives
* Enterprise Relationship Management: Build and maintain deep relationships with R\&D executives, navigating multi\-faceted organizations to identify repeat business opportunities.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with Tempus field teams, lab scientists, and computational biologists to develop novel, multimodal solutions for partners
* Product Evolution: Contribute to the development of the Tempus portfolio by providing "voice of customer" feedback to leadership regarding market trends and emerging scientific questions
* Scientific \& Product Expertise: Serve as the technical expert for Tempus offerings relevant to the customer
* Pipeline Management: Drive the sales process end\-to\-end, from high\-initiative outbound prospecting to qualifying RFPs and managing the close plan.

### **Qualifications \& Experience**

* **Educational Background:**BS/MS in a biological discipline (e.g., Cancer Biology, Molecular Biology, Computational Biology). An advanced degree (PhD, MS, or MBA) is strongly preferred.
* **Industry Expertise:** 7\+ years of experience in Life Sciences Business Development, ideally in the AI drug discovery space
* **Scientific Fluency:**Solid understanding of the drug development lifecycle, from target ID to clinical studies
* **The "Tempus" Mindset:**An entrepreneurial, proactive approach with the ability to thrive in a high\-growth, fast\-paced environment where science meets technology.
* **Communication:** Exceptional ability to articulate complex scientific issues and present technical capabilities to both internal stakeholders and external executives.

### **Success in the First Year**

* First 90 Days: Build a prioritized account/territory plan and establish a consistent outbound cadence with pharma decision\-makers.
* 6–12 Months: Generate a predictable flow of qualified pharma opportunities and maintain healthy pipeline coverage against quota.

**Travel:** Approximately 30–50%

**Location:** Remote (U.S.)


The expected salary range above is applicable if the role is performed from Illinois and may vary for other locations (California, Colorado, New York). Actual salary may vary based on qualifications and experience. Tempus offers a full range of benefits, which may include incentive compensation, restricted stock units, medical and other benefits depending on the position.


We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.


  
### **About Us**


Tempus was founded in August of 2015 by Eric Lefkofsky, after his wife was diagnosed with Breast Cancer. Shortly after he founded the company in an effort to bring the power of technology and artificial intelligence to cancer care, he convinced Ryan Fukushima to join as the company’s first employee. Ryan and Eric began assembling a world class team, focused on building the first version of a platform capable of ingesting real time healthcare data in an effort to personalize diagnostics.


We built the platform for oncology and have expanded it to neuropsychiatry, cardiology, infectious disease (through COVID), and radiology. Despite our rapid growth, our mission remains the same—to help make sure patients are on the right drug at the right time, so they can live longer and healthier lives.

  



### **Why Work Here?**

  

  

We’re looking for people who can change the world.

  

Who question the status quo and don’t shy away from tough problems. For the builders who are never done building and the learners who are never done learning. We’re looking for passionate people with undying curiosity. Those who want to attack one of the most challenging problems mankind has ever faced. Head on.
